facts.fact: The Teatro Degollado was inaugurated in September1866.
The building is Neoclassical and was designed by Jacobo Gálvez.
The first performance was Donizetti opera Lucia di Lammermoor with Ángela Peralta.
The main hall has painting interpreting CantoIV of the Divine Comedy.
The theatre is a performing arts venue and home to the Jalisco Philharmonic Orchestra.
